source_refs.note: Upper Respiratory Tract Infections: a main subheading of 10.4 Respiratory disorders, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 228-229.

blocks.text: Upper respiratory tract infections (URIs) naak, gale, sinuses aur larynx ko mutasir karte hain. Yeh saans ke chhote qatron (respiratory droplets, jaise khansi ya chheenk ke qatre) se aasani se ek insaan se doosre ko lag jate hain.

Sinusitis sinuses ki andar ki tah (lining) ki sozish (inflammation) hai. Sinuses nasal cavity ke gird hawa se bhari chaar jodi jagahein hain: aankhon ke neeche, aankhon ke upar, aankhon ke beech aur aankhon ke peeche. Sinusitis acute (7 se 10 din rehne wali) ya chronic (12 hafton se zyada rehne wali) ho sakti hai. Zyada tar sinusitis virus se hoti hai; kuch bacteria se, aur kabhi kabhar fungi se bhi.

blocks.alt: Daen taraf mun kiye sar ka pehlu se manzar, naak aur aankhon ke gird chaar rangeen sinus groups ke saath: ek aankhon ke oopar maathe mein, ek aankhon ke peeche, ek aankhon aur naak ke beech, aur ek aankhon ke neeche gaal mein.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.10: Sinuses (textbook ki Figure 10.10 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Above eyes, Behind eyes, Between eyes and nose, Under eyes.

blocks.text: Alamaat (symptoms): bukhar, band naak, naak se peep jaisa maada, soonghne ki taqat khatam hona, chehre mein dard, aisa lagna ke balgham naak ke peeche se gale mein gir raha hai, aur sar dard jo jhukne par kabhi barh jata hai.

Ilaj (treatment): zyada tar cases virus se hote hain aur antibiotics ke baghair theek ho jate hain. Agar bacteria se ho to aam tor par antibiotics ya sulpha drugs di jati hain. Doctor nebulization (dawa ki bhaap saans se dena) bhi de sakta hai jo sinuses aur naak ki sozish kam karti aur jaldi theek hone mein madad deti hai. Chronic ya baar baar hone wali sinusitis mein naak ki surgery bhi ho sakti hai jis mein jaraseem (pathogens) aur mucus nikale jate hain.

Otitis media middle ear (darmiyani kaan) ki sozish hai. Yeh acute (achanak shuru) ya chronic (chhe hafton se zyada) ho sakti hai. Is ki aam wajah Eustachian tube (kaan ko gale se jodne wali nali) mein fluid ka jama hona hai jo middle ear se nikal nahi pata. Jab yeh fluid nahi nikalta to middle ear mein bacteria aur viruses barhne lagte hain aur otitis media ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Kaan ki qash: bahari kaan aur kaan ki nali eardrum par khatm hoti hai; us ke peeche teen chhoti haddiyon wala middle ear soozish (inflammation) mein hai aur jazvi taur par mayah (fluid) se bhara hai; aage semicircular canals, cochlea aur nerve wala inner ear hai. Eustachian tube middle ear se neeche jati hai aur tang (narrowed) hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.11: Otitis media (textbook ki Figure 10.11 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: External ear, Middle ear, Internal ear, Inflammation and fluid accumulation in the middle ear, Eustachian tube (narrowed).

blocks.text: Alamaat: kaan mein shadeed dard, ek ya dono kaan kheenchna (bachon mein), bukhar, kaan se fluid behna, tawazun (balance) kharab hona aur sunne mein mushkil.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Eustachian tube middle ear ko gale se jodti hai aur fluid ko nikalne deti hai. Jab yeh tang ya band ho jaye to fluid middle ear mein jama ho jata hai aur infection se sozish hoti hai: yahi otitis media hai.
Ilaj: munh se khane wali aur kaan mein dalne wali dard ki dawaein, aur agar bacteria se ho to antibiotics.
